title: social
summary: The complete Benilla friend/ignore/who family is implemented: strict friend-status decoding and local deltas, resolve-then-compose archived chat lines, list/who parses, all add/del/refresh verbs, the quoted /who filter grammar, exact name/guild/level/race/class/zone/term projection, AreaTable zone resolution, and capped byte-exact CMSG_WHO bodies. Live connected verification remains.

openItems.text: SMSG_FRIEND_STATUS result byte and online tail are not decoded (ApplyFriendStatus just re-requests CMSG_FRIEND_LIST) - none of the ERR_FRIEND_*/ERR_IGNORE_* results (list full, not found, wrong faction, already, self...) are surfaced to the player as the reference client's chat-frame messages
openItems.resolution: Added strict result-keyed SMSG_FRIEND_STATUS decoding, local friend/ignore delta application, exact GlobalStrings templates for all known results, and resolve-then-compose name handling flushed by SMSG_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE. Focused clinical checks pin bytes, malformed rejection, state transitions, copy, and production wiring.

openItems.text: CMSG_WHO builder is hard-coded to the default query with only a player-name substring - no level min/max, guild filter, race/class masks, zone-id list, or free search terms, and no WHO_MAX_ZONES/WHO_MAX_SEARCH_TERMS trimming (the /who filter-string parsing Benilla implements app-side is absent)
openItems.resolution: Ported Benilla's forgiving quoted /who grammar and full WhoRequest projection. Tagged name/guild/class/race/zone fields, exact and ranged levels, AreaTable name-to-id resolution, fallback terms, masks, and the server's 10-zone/4-term caps feed the exact CMSG_WHO field order. Focused checks pin parsing and bytes.

openItems.text: Live verification: add/remove a friend and ignore, observe online/offline transitions and representative refusals, and submit quoted /who filters covering name/guild/level/class/race/zone/free terms; confirm immediate list deltas, exactly one localized line, and server results matching every filter.
